notes.title: Aftermath
notes.content:
[h2]Technical Report[/h2][p]
As requested, the next episode was released as is. There were a few weeks taken to get everything migrated to a patch and fully tested. Some things were not as stable as originally thought, and certain features had to be postponed.

[/p][h3]Chapter Selection[/h3][p]
The main feature that didn't pass testing in the eleventh hour was a basic chapter select option. Many anticipated problems for players occurred as a result of its absence, and it remains one of the next priorities. It will likely see a few more iterations before release, and will be a hard requirement before next episode.

Now that release support is winding down, work on this can begin again.

[/p][h3]Improved Save Data[/h3][p]
Adjacent to this, there are a lot of issues with the way save data works. The underlying issues here also need to be solved as part of chapter selection.

The improved layout is expected to make save games less prone to certain types of corruption. Not everything, but it will likely avoid a fair number of common issues.

The added metadata will also open up what can be provided in the UI, and include more information about the save itself.

[/p][h3]Puzzles[/h3][p]
A strong discussion consensus, and numerous issue reports, express that many of the puzzles in specific areas were more of a drag on the story, rather than an intermission. More hints were added, and removal of red herrings were done to alleviate some friction, as this wasn't the intended experience.


[/p][h2]Author's Remarks[/h2][p]
There is not enough spoiler free content yet that is fully rendered, and can be presented as teaser material this month.

[/p][h3]Words of Gratitude[/h3][p]
Big thank you to everyone who reported issues. Your efforts have contributed a lot to the stability of the newest episode. 

There were also requests for quality of life improvements which are being taken into consideration.

Hope you enjoyed Decay part 1/2!
[/p]

notes.title: Cry About It! Update
notes.content:
[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] Maximum saves increased to 50 slots.
[*] Cutscene coloration now matches the tint of the game scene.
[*] Fixed various typos, grammatical errors, and confusing wording.
[/list][h3]Episode 1[/h3]
[list]
[*] Gave dead-end a title and cutscene art.
[*] Andrew is no longer hyperbolic about the news.
[*] Added more optional dialogue when inspecting the apartment.
[/list][h3]Episode 2[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added additional prompts to save progress.
[*] Added NPCs with minor dialogue to the town area.
[*] Added more hints when wandering around the new house.
[*] Added full character art for the shopkeeper and cultists.
[*] Added more cutscene art to emphasize a key line of dialogue.
[*] Improved Tar Soul-To-be design (No longer just a color swap).
[*] The paintings puzzle tutorial now requires both items to proceed.
[*] More emphasis added to the symbolism for the final paintings puzzle.
[*] Changed some text for key choices to imply how the characters will respond.
[/list][h3]Episode 3[/h3]
[list]
[*] Released Episode 3: Decay (part 1/2).
[/list]
[h3]Translation Tool[/h3]

The newest version of the translation tool has been included in this patch, as it has features to update existing translation files. See the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2378900/discussions/2/594019168548839653/]Translation Tool[/url] thread for more information.

[h3]Possible Save Game Issues[/h3]

The current save game files may or may not work, as they might contain things removed from the game, or lack things recently added. Generally files closest to the start or end of an episode will be the least likely to be corrupt.

Minor issues can sometimes be solved by moving in and out of the room the game was saved in.

While efforts have been made to preserve save games as best as possible, some breakage scenarios are unavoidable when making major content changes. Your ongoing patience regarding these Early Access issues is greatly appreciated.

Please use the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2378900/discussions/1/]Bug Reports and Technical Support[/url] board to report bugs, typos, and other game issues.

notes.title: Progress Report #6
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43894685/5f393006f7f7313f81b24899bba0b42a28ee17bc.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43894685/e171dfad2057be74ae85a5c2dcc853545a830f94.png[/img]


[h2]Kit9 Studio - Progress Report[/h2]

Some major news to report on the state of the game.


[h3]Episode Changes[/h3]

The original plan was to conclude the game in episode 3 with a variety of endings for each of the two branches. As the master script continues being adapted into game content, it has become clear that the structure of episode 3 won't be able contain the full story.

It has been decided to expand the game to include a fourth episode, as cutting or compressing content would be detrimental to what was originally planned and written last year.

Episode 3 is going to be rather lengthy, and will still be released as two major content updates separately.

The new episode format will look like this:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43894685/9999c5d0ebb9220c69ab10456473a5ef65e0dcf0.png[/img]


[h3]Release Plans[/h3]

Not much has changed, apart from an additional episode. All major updates will be patched in at no additional cost to those who already own the game. Each of these major content releases will mark a small price increase in the final game.

When the game play content for the next major release is fully setup, a more detailed estimate of the work remaining will be outlined.


[h3]Minor Patch[/h3]

Fixed some minor typos and bugs. There was also an issue with builds having minor differences in file metadata, causing large patch sizes. This has been fixed, so this should be the last time a minor patch will have such a large download size.

notes.title: Minor Patch v2.0.10
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added additional fall-backs for when Steam fails to synchronize with the game.
[*] When failures occur, achievements will be stored in the global game data and awarded later.
[/list]

A few people have experienced issues where Steam is unable to transmit the App ID to the game the first times they try starting up. Some additional efforts and checks have been added to try to work around this. In the worst case scenario, the game should be able to carry on, but without the ability to award achievements.

In these situations, the game will now store achievements in the game data, and award them the next time the game can launch and synchronize with the game data.

More fixes to come.

Please use the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2378900/discussions/1/]Bugs, Typos, Issues, and Support[/url] board to report any problems.

[h2]Kit9 Studio - Progress Report[/h2]

[h3]Episode 3[/h3]

Development on episode 3 has been progressing steadily. This month a lot of new puzzle segments were prototyped, tested, and roughly finished.

A major story section was also recently finished, and a new one has begun.


[h3]Australia - Region Restriction Lifted[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43894685/6d829e440dc47a6290d98e042c2722a8d873a160.png[/img]

The issue related to availability in Australia has been resolved for the time being, and the game should now be available for sale once again on Steam. The game now has a rating of 18+ for high impact themes.

However, this is not a permanent resolution. Game ratings can be changed or revoked, and some countries have legal mandates related to ratings. This can determine whether a game can be sold on a digital market or not.

Australia's classification law reserves the following:

[quote][b]Section 21A:[/b] Revocation of classification of films or computer games that are found to contain contentious material[/quote]

Just be aware that the availability of this game on Steam could be dropped from certain regional markets at any time.

In such events, this generally only affects the sales and store presence of the game. [b]If you already own the game you should still have access to it in your Steam Library.[/b]


[h3]Game Sale[/h3]

With the above situation in mind, the game is 20% off this week.


[h3]Next Patch[/h3]

Patch 2.0.10 is coming soon. It will be a minor fix patch that aims to fix the issues with music buffering by caching all audio data in memory, rather than repeatedly streaming from disk.

notes.content:

[h2]Kit9 Studio - Progress Report[/h2]

Happy new year. Here is the first progress report for 2024.

[h3]Scheduling[/h3]

The current plan is to try to get progress reports out on the first week of each month. Ideally the first day if no delays are encountered.

Since the build is quite stable now, general patches will also be aimed to ship the same day as the report. With the exception of urgently needed hotfixes.

This should help keep things consistent and predictable for those following the development progress.

[h3]Branch Confusion[/h3]

Based on impressions from some discussions regarding how episode 2 ends, there is confusion about the differences between the episode 3 branches.

It might be worth clarifying, that the endings of episode 2 are not indicators of a "good" or "bad" ending trajectory. Decay and Burial will be two entirely unique story branches. Each will have a variety of outcomes of their own.

[h3]Next Work[/h3]

There is an audio playback fix that is still pending. It was postponed, as it needs more stress testing. This might come in the next patch.

Another thing being evaluated for the near future is a pair of quality of life features. One being better saved game labels, and the other a chapter selection menu. It is too early to say when this will be completed and ready to ship, as it needs to be very thoroughly tested to avoid breaking game data as much as possible.

[h3]Minor Patch[/h3]

This month's patch corrects a fair number of typos, and fixes a couple minor gameplay related issues.

notes.title: Minor Patch v2.0.4 / Demo Issues
notes.content:
[h2]Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*]Fixed a typo.
[*]Fixed a CG where Ashley was missing her choker.
[*]Remove duplicate items from inventory upon entering a certain house.
[/list]

[h2]Demo Issues[/h2]

The demo has been taken down for maintenance.  There are several issues when loading a demo save file in the released game.

A demo save works fine when saved from the prompt at the end. Issues arise when loading a save game made during the demo before completing Episode 1. Certain scenes can allow for duplicate items, which can cause soft-locks in Episode 2.

Once a save file continued from the demo has accumulated enough bad data, there is little that can be done from inside the game to detect and recover from it.  If you have encountered this specific problem, and need a game file repaired, you can submit them to our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2378900/discussions/1/]support thread[/url].

Going forward, the demo will be relaunched when it can safely be branched from the current release.  There is some pending work that needs to be finished before this can be done.

Sorry for the inconvenience.

notes.title: Devlog 06
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43894685/de02eb26d0cebfaff9e4a235c15aeb2cf4676f64.png[/img]


After much consideration, The Coffin of Andy and Leyley will enter Early Access on the [b]20th of October 2023[/b].  Thank you everyone who weighed in with their vote.

Here is some information regarding how Early Access will be handled:

[list]
[*] Early Access launches with Episodes 1 and 2 in their final state. (Minus bug and typo fixes.)

[*] You do not pay for the new episodes after purchasing the game once. The new episodes will be patched in as major updates.  Each are likely to take many months to complete.

[*] The final number of episodes will be 4. Two of which are different routes of episode 3.

[*] Localization tools for fan translations are planned to be included.  Details will be announced later.

[*] Full release will be in 2024.
[/list]


Devlogs will continue to be released once a month.

For those who want to wait for the full release, the devlogs will not assume you've played episodes 1 or 2.  You can continue following the development without getting spoiled any more than before.

October's devlog will be a brief release announcement with some additional details.  So these will be the last screenshots before the Early Access launch:
